gap_resolutions.source_topic: Adoption status subject and old effective

requested/effective 均通过 definition_ref 在同一离线 definitions 中查各自不可变定义和窗口；timing 只保留观测时间。final_constraints 显式绑定实际 effective 定义、合成scope和input_sha256，并声明完整性。

gap_resolutions.source_topic: Units, numeric wire and disabled constraints
gap_resolutions.resolution: 数值使用严格有限 JSON number，拒绝bool/NaN/Inf；比例为decimal ratio。每个quantity含unit、denominator和source_ref。ENABLED/DISABLED/UNSPECIFIED 分开，null不代表零或无限制。
首批仅 layer=RESEARCH + synthetic=true +本地allowlisted fixture_id；删除实际账户映射。scope/资本元数据不接受account_id、broker_account、platform或target_name等真实账户入口；PAPER/PRODUCTION与跨账户聚合均不在本合同。
交付单个离线packet：definitions +原命名readback字段；共同fixture与同一candidate版本。没有URL、新服务或QRS偏好接口接线，未知消费者不伪造effective。
只提议结构版本；三档数值、共同c、定义窗口和时效资格均不设默认。缺任一必要项显式NOT_CONFIGURED。所有参数与适用范围不自动生效。

null = no selection; null definition_ref = selection without complete configured parameters

Replaces old flat status/reason_codes/missing_parameters; subject is current requested. Time/evidence belongs to request handling only. No duplicate top-level status.

Only effective-observation freshness. Missing effective observation => MISSING; qualification/clock unknown => UNKNOWN or validation issue, never system-time fallback. Independent from new request_status.

one record per material stage/fold, unique stage+subject; preserve raw namespaces/unknown values. No outer COMPUTED/SUCCEEDED override. All values belong to the same effective observation/input, never to a different pending request.
Effective observation only, with actual supplied revisions/input/evidence binding. Not the new request acknowledgement. No effective => null; no Git-main/version substitution.

Effective observation only: observed_at/asof/available_at/valid_until. Request processing time lives solely in request_status.processed_at. Definition windows remain per-reference lookups; never generated_at/Date.now fallback.

synthetic fixture only; no account_id/real balances/real FX; no NAV/currency/FX default. All ratio denominators bind this exact input/window. All values belong to the same effective observation/input, never to a different pending request.

never requested limits mislabeled final. No effective => null; missing required limits/source/input cannot be COMPLETE or risk APPROVE. Window comes from bound effective definition. Numeric items use LimitItem, cash_symbol uses the separate identifier type; bind the same effective observation.

existing budget raw status APPROVE/REDUCE/PARKED preserved; quantities use frozen units/basis. PARKED/REDUCE are research assessments, not executed orders or liquidation. All values belong to the same effective observation/input, never to a different pending request.
only approved fixture-derived explanation; no account identifiers or internal deployment progress
no action, deployment, approval, or risk-increase semantics

definition_ref_rule: preset_id plus exact definition_ref resolves one complete packet-local definition. Requested and effective may resolve different definitions/windows. Hash excludes its own hash/readback/display state; canonical JSON sorted compact allow_nan=False, preserving meaningful array order. Digest proves integrity only.

shape.unit: fixed by the closed numeric constraint field table

rules: ENABLED requires explicitly supplied finite value, known unit/denominator/source; no default conversion
DISABLED requires an explicitly allowed optional constraint and an explicit definition; value=null
UNSPECIFIED requires value=null and yields NOT_CONFIGURED for a necessary parameter
JSON bool is not a numeric value; NaN/Infinity and noncanonical percent strings are rejected
Unknown or missing does not mean zero/no limit; UI does not multiply c/scalar or recalculate weights/fees/returns
quantity_wire.applies_only_to: Numeric constraint LimitItem values; not identifiers, bare NAV, scalar, weights, or all arbitrary packet fields

units: The field_type_unit_denominator_table is the sole wire/unit/basis definition; no alternate numeric identifier wrapper, dynamic registry or unit inference.

constraints.disabled: Only explicitly disabled optional max_one_way_risk_turnover; identifiers and required caps cannot use DISABLED
constraints.cash_bridge: virtual residual vs tradable cash security must be explicit; no cash ETF mapped to free zero-return cash; unsupported consumer => CAPABILITY_MISSING

status_precedence: forbidden scope/malformed wire => validator rejection with issues, no implicit lookup
complete request without request acknowledgement => request_status.status=UNKNOWN, regardless of a separately retained old effective
confirmed handling results NOT_APPLIED/APPLIED/REJECTED are only for the exact requested selection; their processed_at/evidence_key are separate
effective observation fields are resolved independently; missing effective=>MISSING/null, stale effective=>STALE, unknown raw observation state preserved
validator cannot invent processing/observation times or rewrite old effective from new request state
old_effective_rule: Request state is only request_status. A new UNKNOWN/REJECTED/NOT_APPLIED/NOT_CONFIGURED request may coexist with an independently evidenced old effective and its own FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN observation. Sole source/timing/capital/upstream/assessment/final limits refer to that old observation. No new-request success. Expired policy reference is not current effective; its historical evidence may remain in the supplied sidecar.
parameter_rule: Do not choose common c, numeric caps, enabled constraints, effective_from/expires_at or freshness thresholds. No complete configured/effective fixtures are fabricated this round. Missing parameter means NOT_CONFIGURED.
c_definition: same existing RS06 quadratic approximation mu^T w - w^T Sigma w/(2c); clip_scale uses c*Sigma^-1*mu once. c is not a capital exposure cap, is common across presets, and remains unset. No Bayesian or new solver.
upstream_rule: preserve stage/subject raw statuses and reasons; assessment and adoption are separate; failure never becomes permission
dependency_rule: Use actual fixed QPK revision/source evidence after an explicitly scoped dependency adoption. fe0f404 is local reviewed fix, not a published version; old f6 not changed. Do not force UES tests into an old production pin or relabel overlays as installation.
transport: Single offline packet + one reviewed validator-input sidecar passed as parsed objects. No URL/service, no filesystem lookup inside validator. No new risk algorithm or product implementation.

validator_inputs.fixture_clock: explicit UTC instant for nonempty window/freshness predicates; explicit null permitted only when no time predicate is required (F0). Never infer now/generated_at.

validator_inputs.canonical_record_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact sorted-key JSON, ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False; evidence record has no self-digest field. Compare only with the explicitly supplied manifest map.
